custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the baked goods. AI often struggles with the porous, irregular nature of bread/scone crumbs, making them look waxy or overly smooth. Also, verify the plate geometry; AI frequently distorts elliptical perspectives of rims. The background is intentionally blurred, so do not penalize lack of detail there, but check for 'smearing' artifacts at the boundary between sharp foreground and blurred background.
